name: Roger Wodehouse's Androgymnasium
tagline: A feature film comedy about what happens when a glam rock star makes a children's TV show
description: Roger Wodehouse's Androgymnasium is a feature film comedy produced by a seasoned team with credits at Netflix, FX, NBC, and Tribeca. The story follows a fictional glam rock icon tasked with creating a children's television program, blending original music with character-driven humor. The project features a stacked comedy cast and is directed by SXSW award-winner Lauren Ludwig. This production leverages independent financing to maintain creative control over its unique queer-inclusive narrative.

founders.name: Lauren Ludwig
founders.bio: Queer filmmaker who has directed for FX, NBC, Sony, and TruTV. Their indie pilot EVERYONE TOGETHER won “Best Comedy Pilot” at SeriesFest 2020.

updates.title: Campaign Launch
updates.body: Successfully launched our community round to bring this glam rock comedy to life with $113k already committed.

highlights: Stacked comedy cast and original music
Directed by SXSW award-winner Lauren Ludwig
Proven team behind hits from Netflix, FX, and NBC
Independent film model with high creative control

name: Startup Science
tagline: A unified platform connecting founders, mentors, and startup programs.
description: Startup Science is a comprehensive software platform designed to standardize the entrepreneurial journey through data-driven methodology. Trusted by over 88,000 founders and 200 global partners, the platform provides infrastructure for startup ecosystems to manage mentorship and program scaling. Led by serial entrepreneur Gregory Shepard, who has achieved 12 exits, the company aims to reduce the high failure rate of startups using a science-based approach to growth.

founders.name: Gregory Shepard
founders.bio: Serial entrepreneur with 12 exits, ranging from $25M to $1B. Author of The Startup Lifecycle and host of a Forbes podcast.

updates.title: Scaling Global Partnerships
updates.body: Now serving over 200 global partners and 88,000 founders via our ecosystem infrastructure.

highlights: 88,000 founders and 200+ global partners on platform
Founder has 12 exits including four private equity awards
Over $5.5M in prior funding from institutional investors
SaaS model for startup accelerators and ecosystems

name: Namecoach
tagline: Making name pronunciation flawless with voice AI
description: Namecoach provides a proprietary voice AI platform that ensures accurate name pronunciation and gender pronoun usage across enterprise systems. By integrating with tools like Salesforce, Microsoft Outlook, and Canvas, Namecoach helps organizations foster inclusion and sense of belonging during critical interactions. The company serves hundreds of higher education institutions and a growing list of Fortune 500 companies to solve the problem of name mispronunciation in professional settings.

founders.name: Praveen Shanbhag
founders.bio: Former White House Science & Tech Analyst and Stanford Lecturer. Holds a PhD from Stanford and an MPhil from Cambridge.

updates.title: Strong Revenue Growth
updates.body: Reached $4M ARR with 90% gross profit margins as we expand into the enterprise market.

highlights: Backed by Founders Fund and Stanford StartX
$4M ARR with 90% Gross Profit Margin
Integrates with Salesforce, Outlook, and Microsoft Teams
Over $25M total capital raised to date

name: UTIX
tagline: Join the ticketing revolution: Invest in blockchain-secure events
description: UTIX is a blockchain-based ticketing platform built on the Ethereum network designed to eliminate fraud and secondary market price gouging. By using smart contracts, UTIX allows event organizers to set price caps on resales and ensure ticket authenticity through a secure digital ledger. The company operates within the MFSA-regulated framework, providing a transparent and lower-fee alternative to traditional ticketing giants in the $53B global market.

founders.name: Max Mayhew
founders.bio: Former Head of Trading at Ceres Fund and Portfolio Manager at Carbon Capital. Specialized in industrial economics and blockchain.

updates.title: Beta Expansion
updates.body: Successfully processed over $300k in ticketing volume through our Ethereum-integrated platform.

highlights: MFSA-regulated Ethereum token model
Targeting $53B ticketing market with blockchain security
Smart contract enabled price caps on ticket resales
Lower fees compared to legacy ticketing platforms

name: Field Store House
tagline: Fine-dining couple creating a farm & inn on the North Shore of Lake Superior
description: Field Store House is a regenerative agriculture and hospitality project developing a 40-acre farm and inn on the North Shore of Lake Superior. Founded by a couple with experience in Michelin-starred establishments like The French Laundry, the project combines high-end culinary expertise with sustainable land management. The development includes a boutique inn, foraged food programs, and a farm stand, capitalizing on the growing demand for agri-tourism in the Midwest.

founders.name: Seth O'Donovan
founders.bio: Culinary expert with experience at The French Laundry and Frasca Food & Wine. Specialist in butchery and fermentation.

updates.title: Site Development Underway
updates.body: Progressing on our 40-acre site with validated demand from sold-out pilot dining events.

highlights: 40-acre site currently under development
Founded by Michelin-star culinary veterans
Validated demand via sold-out farm stand events
Unique blend of regenerative farming and luxury hospitality
